contracts_defined: tests/sprint-state-machine.test.mjs header block (lines 1-130) — Phase S2 deterministic-sprint-orchestration contract surface: (a) loadSprint(sprintPath) loads a sprint JSON, validates dependency graph, returns a state-machine object; throws on cycle with dependency_cycle (never propagates a raw stack trace); (b) computeReadyStories(sprint) returns a deterministic array of story ids that are ready to run; empty state returns [] (NEVER vacuously [ready]); (c) applyResult(machine, roleResult, options) validates roleResult against the schema, rejects malformed results with classified reasons, rejects stale results with stale_result, accepts well-formed results; (d) validateRoleResult(roleResult, schema) returns {ok, reason?} for any shape; never throws; (e) isBaselineStale(baselineSha, currentHead) returns true when baseline_sha is not an ancestor of HEAD; (f) recordScopeChange(machine, change) records {type, capacity_effect, approver} (and evidence for additions/removals) BEFORE the story state transitions; rejects with incomplete_scope_change when capacity_effect or approver is missing; (g) persistState(machine, storePath) writes the current state atomically (no credentials in written state); (h) rebuildState(storePath) rebuilds a state-machine object from the durable store; nextPermittedAction must equal the value computed BEFORE persistence; (i) nextPermittedAction(machine) returns {role, storyId, baselineSha} as a structured object; byte-identical across calls; (j) terminalStateOf(story) returns 'done' / 'blocked' / 'deferred' / undefined (active); (k) concurrentReviewPaths(machine, reviewRoles) returns an array of distinct result paths, one per reviewer; (l) filterBannedTerms(items, bannedTerms) does NOT drop entries containing banned terms (A7 defense).

test_inventory.name: ready stories: stories whose dependencies are not yet met are NOT ready
ready stories: empty state must NOT vacuously report ready (anti-pattern A4)
ready stories: cycle in dependencies fails with classified reason, not a stack trace
invalid role results: malformed JSON / missing required fields → classified failure, not a stack trace
stale audits: baseline_sha not an ancestor of HEAD → rejected with stale_result (central A1 guard)
remediation invalidation: after a role's HEAD changes, prior acceptance is invalidated; rerun required
concurrent review isolation: two parallel reviewers write to distinct, isolated result paths
resume: persist state, kill the in-process state, rebuild from durable store, next action is identical
scope changes: mid-sprint addition/removal requires capacity_effect + approver BEFORE story state transitions
terminal states: done / blocked / deferred correctly identified (no vacuous 'active')
A3 probe: counts in the state machine are labeled structures, never bare integers
A5 probe: every transition record carries a source-state id; transition without source-state id fails closed
A7 probe: refutation filter does NOT mask real failures (banned-term + filter-word probe)
A8 probe: deterministic output — no timestamps or randomness in any structured sprint state
